sections.title: Holistic Wellness & Yoga
sections.description: Recharge your mind and body. Find your center with our outdoor yoga sessions amidst the calming embrace of nature, breathing in the pure mountain air.

sections.title: Infinity Swimming Pool
sections.description: Float seamlessly between the resort's luxury and the raw beauty of the wilderness. A tranquil escape offering breathtaking views of the valley.

image.alt: Golden sunset reflecting on the infinity pool

sections.title: Indoor Recreation
sections.description: Step away from the screens and relive golden memories. Our cozy indoor lounge is equipped with classic board games, perfect for lazy afternoons and family bonding.

sections.title: Bonfire Celebrations
sections.description: Gather around the warmth of a crackling fire. Share untold stories, pour a glass of fine wine, and celebrate the crisp Sahyadri nights with your loved ones.

image.alt: Group of friends enjoying wine by the bonfire
